verdict.rationale: Mercury's docs explicitly market instant virtual card creation scoped to purposes like ad spend or vendor use, backed by spend controls/limits and an API for issuing/managing card lifecycle, and a 5-year customer corroborates creating hundreds of individually-limited virtual cards in practice. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of merchant-lock/single-vendor restriction mechanics beyond naming and limits, and independent confirmation specifically of 'purpose-scoped' (vs just limited) cards.
